SUPERHUMAN_POWER.title: Superhuman
SUPERHUMAN_POWER.description: Your Strikes and Defends can be upgraded [blue]{Amount}[/blue] additional {Amount:plural:time|times}.
VASSALS_POWER.title: Vassals
VASSALS_POWER.description: This combat, your Strikes and Defends upgrade each time they are used.
DIGNITY_POWER.title: Dignity
DIGNITY_POWER.description:
Whenever you play a [gold]Strike[/gold], gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you play a [gold]Defend[/gold], deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
ATTENDANT_POWER.title: Attendant!
ATTENDANT_POWER.description: This turn, your Strikes and Defends cost 0.
MAJESTY_POWER.title: Majesty
MAJESTY_POWER.description: This turn, your Strikes target ALL enemies.
GHOST_ARISTOCRAT_NEXT_TURN_POWER.title: Ghost Aristocrat
GHOST_ARISTOCRAT_NEXT_TURN_POWER.descrip: Next turn, your Strikes and Defends deal double damage and gain double Block.
GHOST_ARISTOCRAT_POWER.title: Ghost Aristocrat
GHOST_ARISTOCRAT_POWER.description: This turn, your Strikes and Defends deal double damage and gain double Block.
DEFENDS_FREE_EXHAUST_POWER.title: Cool-Headed Blow
DEFENDS_FREE_EXHAUST_POWER.description: This turn, your Defends cost 0 but gain Exhaust.
HIGH_SOCIETY_POWER.title: High Society
HIGH_SOCIETY_POWER.description: For this combat, your Strikes and Defends gain Exhaust. Whenever a Strike or Defend is Exhausted, add a random Rare card into your hand.
ANCESTRAL_PRECEPTS_POWER.title: Ancestral Precepts
ANCESTRAL_PRECEPTS_POWER.description: This combat, your Innate cards cost 1 less.
GOLD_BLOOD_POWER.title: Golden Blood
GOLD_BLOOD_POWER.description: Whenever you take unblocked damage, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Gold.
BILLIONAIRE_POWER.title: Billionaire
BILLIONAIRE_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Gold. This amount decreases by [blue]1[/blue] each time it triggers.
PATRON_POWER.title: Patron
PATRON_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, spend [blue]5[/blue] Gold and gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
VANITY_POWER.title: Vanity
VANITY_POWER.description: Whenever you gain or spend Gold, deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
COLLECTING_POWER.title: Collection
COLLECTING_POWER.description: Whenever you deal attack damage to the target this turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Gold.
GOLDEN_ARMOR_NEXT_TURN_POWER.title: Golden Armor
BLUE_BLOODED_POWER.title: Chosen
BLUE_BLOODED_POWER.description: Whenever you play an [gold]Innate[/gold] card, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Gold.
PRIVILEGE_POWER.title: Privilege
PRIVILEGE_POWER.description: The first [gold]Innate[/gold] card you play each turn costs [blue]0[/blue].
LAW_POWER.title: Law
LAW_POWER.description: Your [gold]Innate[/gold] cards have [gold]Retain[/gold]. Whenever an [gold]Innate[/gold] card is retained, its cost is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
NEXT_TURN_DRAW_POWER.title: Next Turn Draw
NEXT_PERK_TRIGGERS_POWER.title: Born Ruler
NEXT_PERK_TRIGGERS_POWER.description: The next [gold]Perk[/gold] card you play triggers its [gold]Perk[/gold] an extra time.
PRIDE_FORM_POWER.title: Pride Form
PRIDE_FORM_POWER.description: At the end of each turn, play [blue]{Amount}[/blue] random [gold]Innate[/gold] {Amount:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] and [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
FREE_GIFT_POWER.title: Free Gift
FREE_GIFT_POWER.description: Whenever you play a card with a [gold]Perk[/gold], draw [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:card|cards}.
ROYAL_GUARD_POWER.title: Royal Guard
ROYAL_GUARD_POWER.description: The first [gold]Innate[/gold] card you play manually each turn is played twice.
